title: Concept: Unbounded scanf conversion (c) — review required
description: In c, sscanf(b, "%s", o) reads a string without a width limit, so a long token overruns the destination buffer. The remedy is a conversion that carries a width (a %N width) and a check on the input length.
applicability: c native code; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Stack or heap overflow; HIGH severity.
